== Summary ==
Soldier of Orange. Koen Meijssen of the Netherlands takes it easy after Star Wars CCG World Finals Day 1 rounds are finished. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Koen Meijssen]].
